title: UnrealTournament
detail: 469e renders the intro map at native 1920x1080 via D3D9Drv.D3D9RenderDevice; FLEETRES wrote FullscreenViewportX/Y=1920/1080 and StartupFullscreen=True into System\UnrealTournament.ini. title: UnrealTournament436
detail: RE-VERIFIED FULLSCREEN. UT's own F11=Shot bind (already in the staged User.ini) writes System\Shot####.bmp and WORKS in exclusive fullscreen - that is the capture route for both UT trees on this box, no Alt+Enter needed. Frame is 1920x1080 'Tournament DeathMatch in Deck16][' with pigga (ping 9) on the scoreboard beside 5 bots (ping 0), i.e. fullscreen AND joined to the fleet 469e server from a retail 436 client. The agent's GDI SCREENSHOT taken at the same instant was pure black at 1920x1080, which is what proves the surface really was exclusive-fullscreen.
